# Thorne

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

She is a young woman with light curly hair and captivating eyes. She wears gorgeous attire featuring noticeably puffy sleeves.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## Personality

Miss Thorne is an intelligent, compassionate, refined, and gentle educator who draws forth her students' finest qualities and earns their affection. She demonstrates patience and tact while encouraging students to think, reflect, and evaluate their own work critically. Highly dedicated to her pupil's progress, she acts firmly against dishonesty while remaining quick to forgive.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P2](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0002), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013), [v1 c31 P25](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0025), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_

## History

Miss Agnes Thorne was hired by the school trustees as the first female teacher in Brierley. She introduced field days to study nature, daily physical culture routines, biweekly pupil recitations, and alternative composition exercises. To raise funds for a schoolhouse flag, she organized a Christmas concert with the students. Recognizing the potential in her advanced students, she organized an after-school preparation class for the Regent's entrance exam. Despite receiving a job offer in her home district's grade school, she chose to stay in Brierley to see her entrance class through their final year. Her educational methods included urging pupils to write simply and act as their own critics, which occasionally drew skepticism from conservative community members and trustees. Under her guidance, all members of her entrance class passed their exams. When she eventually departed Brierley at the end of her tenure, she left behind a profound legacy among her students, who held her in deep affection and respect.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P6](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0006), [v1 c24 P8](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0008), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013), [v1 c31 P23](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0023), [v1 c31 P25](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0025), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_
